verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel workspaces, so codebase understanding is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence never describes the agent automatically mapping, indexing, or explaining a whole codebase without manual context selection. The only related item is user-driven file-content search (⌘⇧F), which is not agent-driven codebase mapping.
